text:
anya: Quick report: onboarding sample app shows flaky network errors on Android 12. First request often succeeds, subsequent 'List models' taps produce SocketTimeoutException. Logs show okhttp3.internal.http2.StreamResetException and occasional 'timeout on read'.

rachel: Which OkHttp version and client config in the sample? Any custom interceptors?

anya: Using the sample's default client + our auth interceptor. OkHttp 4.9.3. We set readTimeout(0, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS) to allow long streaming responses. retryOnConnectionFailure is true.

paul: readTimeout(0) = infinite. Some Android network stacks misbehave with infinite read timeouts and HTTP/2 streams can be cancelled. Also, if the Authenticator triggers a retry and the request has a non-repeatable body, the replay will fail. Are we recreating the client per button click?

anya: Oh yeah the sample constructs the client inside the button handler (oops). That probably kills connection reuse. Reproduced on emulator and Pixel 4a.

rachel: Two actionables: (1) make the OkHttpClient a singleton (Application-level), (2) avoid readTimeout(0) on Android — use a large finite value like 2 minutes. Third: ensure Authenticator doesn't attempt to replay streaming one-shot bodies.

paul: For Authenticator best practice: return a new Request that only retries idempotent requests or attach a fresh token for non-streaming ones. If you must retry, wrap bodies that support repeat by buffering (but that's memory-expensive).

anya: Quick local test: moved client to singleton, changed readTimeout to 2 minutes, and temporarily set retryOnConnectionFailure(false). After 30 runs, stable on Android 12 emulator. Re-enable retryOnConnectionFailure and still stable. Seems like combination of infinite read timeout + client-per-request + Authenticator replay was the culprit.

deploy-bot: Created issue #2542: "sample-app: infinite readTimeout + per-request OkHttpClient + Authenticator replay causes intermittent SocketTimeoutException on Android 12" https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/issues/2542

rachel: Thanks. Can you send a PR to update sample defaults and add a README troubleshooting note about Authenticator replays and non-idempotent bodies? Also include the recommended OKHttp config snippet.

anya: Yep, PR incoming. I'll include a small integration test that ensures the client isn't re-created per UI action. Thanks for the help! :rocket:
